snippet.title: 4:LOOP - The Game Awards 2025 Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PC Games
snippet.description:
4:LOOP™ is a four-player co-op shooter set in an original sci-fi universe. Experiment. Improvise. See if you can beat the odds. 

Interested in being selected for upcoming playtests? Please visit https://www.play4loop.com for more information.

Coming soon to PS5® and PC. Wishlist now.

PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3355360
